_comment: EXAMPLE — generic placeholder entries. Copy to retired.json and list things that are RETIRED/DEAD but that tooling docs might still describe as live. Archived app directories are derived from disk (archived_app_globs in doctor.config.json) and must NOT be listed here. Add a row the day you retire something — that is the whole maintenance cost of this check. A row names the thing that died (the container, the server), never the whole category (the runtime) — otherwise every correct mention of the live replacement fires.

entities.why: example: cache container removed; the service now runs elsewhere, so plain mentions of the service stay live
example: job scheduler removed; jobs moved to another runner
example: old build-output tree deleted; deploy only from the canonical source
